title: Where Red Allen got his ideas; Buddy Petit's harmonies
summary: Punch says Red learned his fingering and freak notes around him; they discuss Buddy Petit's diminished chords and harmonic ideas.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
